Methods of sampling, types of data, and populations vs samples.

All A Level exam boards are obligated to provide a ‘large data set’. Data in exam questions will often be from this set, and you are encouraged to explore this data (which is publicly available) in Microsoft Excel.
It is important to note that you are expected to be familiar with this data set before you go into your exam, including some basic geographic knowledge!
weather data from a number of weather stations

The median daily total rainfall for the same week in Perth was 19.00mm. Karl states that more southerly countries experience higher rainfall during June. State with a reason whether your answer to part (b) supports this statement.

Perth is in Australia, which is south of the UK, and the median rainfall was higher. However, this is a very small sample from a single location in each country so does not provide enough evidence to support Karl’s statement.
